name: Binary Architecture & Crash Dump Diagnostic Suite
author: WinCare Core Team
description: Portable Executable (PE) binary header inspection, ASLR/DEP/CFG security mitigation verification, and system crash dump analyzer.

tools.title: PE Binary Security Mitigation Probe
tools.summary: Inspects executable DOS/NT headers, architecture machine flags, ASLR (DynamicBase), DEP (NXCompat), and Control Flow Guard.

tools.title: Crash Dump Artifact Collector
tools.summary: Audits user-mode and kernel minidump crash artifacts across LocalAppData and Windows Minidump directories.
